HOW TO PLAY

⌨️

Keyboard

← → Arrow keys or A / D to steer your car between lanes. P or Escape to pause.

👆

Mobile

Tap the left/right buttons or swipe anywhere on screen to change lanes.

🛡️

Shields

You have 3 shield points. Each collision loses one. Lose all — game over!

⚡

Speed Up

Game accelerates every 500 points. Higher speed = higher score per second.

💎

Power-Ups

🛡 Shield Restore 1 HP
⚡ Boost 2× score for 5s
🧲 Magnet Auto-collect power-ups
⭐ Star Full invincibility 4s
🚀 Nitro Speed surge for 4s
❄️ Freeze Slows traffic for 5s
💰 Bonus Instant +250 score
🔧 Repair Full heal instantly

🔥

Combos

Dodge 5 cars in a row without hitting to earn score multipliers up to ×5!
